zones.name: Historic north
zones.publicSpace: Bounded stone courtyards, gates and garden paths; keep facade sightlines
zones.vegetation: Composed pines and garden beds outside courts, not on access

zones.name: Modern commercial
zones.publicSpace: Open commercial sidewalks/plazas and service passages; generous clear facade approaches
zones.vegetation: Small formal beds and spaced street trees in defined planters only; no forest carpet

zones.name: Namsan
zones.publicSpace: Accepted terraced trail/entrance and stone park threshold
zones.vegetation: Layered forest on hillside retained; planted setbacks at city edge

zones.name: Rail district
zones.publicSpace: Fine urban entrance plaza, visible tactile access and organized railway surfaces
zones.vegetation: Low peripheral beds away from canopy/track/entrance

zones.name: Amusement
zones.publicSpace: Open paved arrival/queue courts and continuous perimeter pedestrian paths; ride contacts fixed
zones.vegetation: Low framed flowerbeds and restrained perimeter trees; no greenery across circulation

zones.name: Harbor
zones.publicSpace: Continuous public quay, market forecourt, terminal approach and safe stone/timber edge; no extra quay land
zones.vegetation: Low salt-tolerant planting in deliberate coastal beds

zones.name: Jeju
zones.publicSpace: Canonical island/nearshore image immutable; external water and bridge alignment only

materials.URBAN_STONE: Warm gray/beige fine granite pavers 12–28px wide, 8–16px tall, crisp 1px joints; shared with canonical forecourt and Muneum sidewalk; no huge slabs
materials.HERITAGE_STONE: Warm traditional irregular fine stone, restrained seams, original north source authority
materials.ASPHALT: Existing native asphalt, curbs and road centerline registrations retained; continuous logical approaches, no isolated fragments
materials.URBAN_CURB: Native narrow dressed granite curb, tactile path continuity and crosswalks at existing alignment
materials.GARDEN_EARTH: Compacted warm earth, exposed stone and low irregular grass only within garden/park boundaries
materials.STONE_BOUNDARY: Low Korean stone retaining edge or garden border with actual openings at public paths, no arbitrary rectangular ownership edge
materials.PARK_STEPS: Existing accepted Namsan stairs/trails and park entrance retained
materials.PLATFORM_STONE: Fine open platform paving, clear track/edge ownership; original canopy and 8px strip unchanged
materials.QUAY_STONE: Fine gray stone promenade with low coastal wall/railing at real shore, no new land
materials.TIMBER: Native existing bridge/jetty plank pitch; no stretching, approaches meet existing geometry
materials.COAST_BASALT: Natural irregular dark rock/foam grounding of unchanged planned shoreline, not straight texture cutoff
materials.OFFSHORE_WATER: Single coherent offshore blue light/wave scale, native authored turquoise-to-blue transition OUTSIDE canonical Jeju; canonical foam and turquoise untouched
materials.CANONICAL_JEJU: Exact original ground and foreground PNGs and runtime coordinates; no filters or repaints

boundaryPolicy: One world registry; adjacent authors receive this same program and actual shared geometry. Native binary ownership; roads and canonical sources win. No independent palette generation or generic repeating terrain tiles.

reviewerImages.exactMarkedDefectAcceptance: NOT TESTED; textual defect list used, reattachment requested

environmentCorrections.purpose: Continue existing station frontage road into existing avenue with swept curb; no canonical floor write, no platform transfer connector, no new collision/land/route reservation.

environmentCorrections.policy: Authored external coastal water and native1x boundary-water continuation only. Entire canonical image unchanged; no source RGB filters or source scale change.
